topic: Carbon Atom and Organic vs Inorganic Compounds
key_concepts: Carbon has four valence electrons available for bonding
Carbon forms covalent bonds by sharing electrons
Carbon can form single, double, and triple bonds
Carbon atoms can link into straight chains, branched chains, and rings
Carbon-carbon single bonds are strong sigma bonds
Organic compounds contain carbon and hydrogen
Organic compounds include carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids
Carbohydrates serve as energy sources; lipids store energy
Proteins perform most work in cells and regulate tissues and organs
Nucleic acids such as DNA and RNA carry genetic information
Inorganic compounds lack both carbon and hydrogen
